name: hold35k (v4_8) vs MST+SLT baseline: standard training curves on cross / carla / cross_left
scope: Add a 4-way unprotected-left-turn SUMO scenario (cross_left) and train BOTH hold35k (v4_8) and the MST+SLT baseline on cross, carla, and cross_left with one training seed, saving a checkpoint every 2000 raw steps. Afterwards evaluate every historical checkpoint of both methods on all three scenarios (50 episodes each) and draw standard success-rate vs raw-steps training curves.

matrix.pairing: Within every scenario, both methods use training seed 0, the same ordered physical 80/20 high-density traffic partition, deterministic actor-only actions, and the source episode limit.

cross.rationale: Inherited exactly from independent v2: 50% additional social vehicles with delayed clones so ego can depart before merge pressure builds.

carla.rationale: Inherited exactly from independent v2: motor and pedestrian demand are both scaled by 1.35.

cross_left.rationale: Reuse the released 4-arm priority network. Social traffic is straight (both lanes) plus right turns on all four arms; the ego is the sole left-turner (south_in -> west_out), making the unprotected left turn the signature challenge. 40% additional vehicles with 4-6 s clone jitter keeps it on the dense end between left_turn and cross while remaining solvable.

smoke.evidence_scope: Engineering smoke only; never report as a method result.

comparison.evidence_scope: Single-training-seed standard training curves: 6 cells (2 methods x 3 scenarios), 25 checkpoints each, 50 evaluation episodes per checkpoint.

artifact_contract.missing_value_rule: Missing checkpoints remain explicit nulls in the curve; the report warns instead of silently interpolating.
artifact_contract.single_seed_uncertainty_rule: Cross-training-seed standard deviations and significance remain null/not claimed.
